description: This file defines a PHP class 'PasswordStrengthValidation' that evaluates the strength of user passwords using the zxcvbn algorithm. It provides methods to score passwords based on their estimated strength and categorizes them into levels such as very weak, weak, better, strong, and strongest.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidation
classes.description: A utility class that assesses the strength of passwords using the Zxcvbn library and categorizes them into predefined strength levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the password strength validator by instantiating the Zxcvbn library.

methods.name: checkPasswordStrength
methods.description: Accepts a UserCredential object, analyzes the password strength using Zxcvbn, and returns an integer representing the strength level.
